title: Wadi al-Jarf, harbour of Khufu on the Red Sea
summary: Early Old Kingdom harbour on the Red Sea coast of Egypt, used in the 4th Dynasty to sail to copper and turquoise mines in Sinai. Boat-storage galleries cut into the rock held the oldest papyri found, including the logbook of Inspector Merer, which records shipping limestone to Khufu's pyramid at Giza.

uncertainty.note: Archaeology Magazine says the harbour was used for around 50 to 70 years within the 4th Dynasty (ca. 2675-2545 B.C. in its chronology), including Khufu's reign. The papyri come from the end of Khufu's reign. Absolute dates differ between chronologies (the Giza record uses a lower Khufu date).
